headline: “Redevelopment Used to Make Money”—Is That Old News? Expert: “Existing Prices Must Fall Significantly for Projects to Work”
summary: An analysis suggests profits from redevelopment projects may shrink as construction and financing costs rise and contribution burdens grow. Existing prices would need to fall significantly for many projects to work, according to an expert.
why: Redevelopment projects depend on construction costs, financing rates and property prices, which shape developer returns.
